links.comparator_used: LLM outputting all predictions without abstention (no confidence-based selective prediction)
links.outcome: LLM deprescribing recommendation performance with selective prediction (abstaining on low-confidence predictions)
links.effect: Only marginal improvement in performance; no numeric effect reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Confidence estimates were poorly calibrated, so confidence often failed to align with actual success, limiting the value of the abstention threshold.
links.quote: Selective prediction only marginally improved LLM performance due to poorly calibrated confidence estimates.
